campaign: Embedded GUI: typed runtime authority, common operations, and bounded artifact workflows
doctrine: Follow skill.md. This file is the SINGLE execution authority. Keep the browser thin; Go recipes, compiled plans, runtime sessions, RepoDB, and run evidence own behavior. Unsloth is workflow inventory or an oracle only. No family literals, guessed defaults, fixed warning thresholds, duplicate browser state, compatibility paths, or modality-specific job systems. Migrate each caller and delete displaced logic in the same wave.

items.title: Show exact chat context use and server-measured timing without client tokenization or inferred values

steps.title: Count input through the protocol endpoint and display known context, cache, prefill, decode, completion, and elapsed facts
steps.rationale: The server already owns tokenization, admission, and slot timing. The browser displays exact facts and leaves unknowns absent.

items.title: Expose active recipe admission and compiled ordered stages without reconstructing policy in JavaScript

steps.title: Serve and render recipe identity, modules, placement, residency, required facts, cache identity, artifacts, and exact refusal
steps.rationale: Typed recipe and compiled-plan authorities supply display data; unknown modules remain non-executable.

items.title: Own status, cancellation, publication, and failure evidence in one payload-free operation lifecycle

steps.title: Extract the shared Go operation runtime and bind status and cancellation endpoints to it
steps.rationale: Generation, training, export, and analysis need one context-driven lifecycle and one immutable run record, not task-specific managers.

items.title: Drive every admitted generation modality from recipe-provided capabilities and the common operation runtime

steps.title: Add one generation workspace with typed shared controls, recipe-derived optional controls, and compiled request parity with CLI
steps.rationale: One capability description replaces browser family switches and modality-specific forms while preserving existing mathematical execution.

items.title: Browse every output kind through bounded RepoDB summaries and on-demand streamed content

steps.title: Add filtered artifact summaries, producer lineage, explicit missing payload state, and one media-aware gallery
steps.rationale: RepoDB remains the sole catalog. The browser retains metadata only and requests content on demand.

items.title: Expose bounded production-processed dataset previews and immutable run evidence with lineage

steps.title: Extend existing dataset and run handlers and render typed detail without JavaScript parsing or mutable side stores
steps.rationale: Dataset processing and run reconstruction stay with their production Go owners; list and preview bounds come from request and authority limits.

items.title: Run recipe-selected training and export through reusable Go services and the common operation lifecycle

steps.title: Extract command services, expose typed events and exact resume identity, and add training and export controls without subprocess orchestration
steps.rationale: CLI and GUI must call the same service; recipe, inventory, and encoding facts derive configuration and output extents.

items.title: Verify thin-client authority, bounded memory behavior, cancellation, lineage, responsive layout, and full repository integrity

steps.title: Run static, handler, memory, parity, lineage, desktop, mobile, and repository verification; remove the obsolete scrapbook
steps.rationale: Campaign completion requires one operation lifecycle, one capability-driven generation UI, one artifact browser, no browser family policy, and no retained payload duplication.
